tools.name: audit_youtube_channel
tools.description: Scores a YouTube channel out of 100 from its public catalogue and returns the one thing to fix first. Use this when asked how a channel is doing, or to compare a channel against its own history rather than against other channels.

tools.name: get_channel_patterns
tools.description: Returns what measurably works on one channel — title length, duration, posting day and format — each as a lift against that channel's OWN median, with the number of uploads behind it. Use this instead of generic YouTube advice, and when the question is why some of a channel's videos outperform other

tools.name: get_next_video_brief
tools.description: Returns a brief for the channel's next upload — format, length, title shape and posting day — derived from what already outperformed on that channel. Use this when asked what someone should make or publish next.

tools.name: check_monetization_progress
tools.description: Reports how far a channel is from both 2026 Partner Programme tiers — 500 subscribers for fan funding, 1,000 for ad revenue — with the Shorts-views path measured over the last 90 days. Use this when asked whether a channel is close to monetization or what it still needs.

tools.name: suggest_ab_test
tools.description: Suggests title variants to run in YouTube's own Test & Compare, each changing ONE element and each grounded in a pattern measured on that channel. Use this when a creator has a video ready and wants to know what to test rather than whether to test.
